summary: Yasumi Matsuno's standalone Square action RPG set in Ivalice-adjacent Le Monde.

emulation.notes: Use legal disc dumps and test timing-sensitive combat/menu behavior with selected enhancement settings.

primary.why: Vagrant Story is a PlayStation-only game with later PSN availability as a legacy delivery route; DuckStation is the highest-fidelity capture path for the complete original.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped PlayStation disc image in DuckStation with conservative enhancements, or play the PSN PSOne Classic on PS3/PSP/Vita if already owned.
